nonStale: claimUspJobAttempt: cancelled/paused/succeeded logical state, nonclaimable job, or another live attempt -> POINT_ATTEMPT_CHANGED.
assertUspJobAttemptTx: changed job/meta/attempt state, fence, owner, enrollment hash or expired lease -> POINT_ATTEMPT_CHANGED.
acceptUspJobAttempt: superseded completion or expired lease -> POINT_ATTEMPT_CHANGED.
Point publication validator: exact prepared result/enrolled-input mismatch -> POINT_PUBLICATION_CHANGED.
point409.words: POINT_ATTEMPT_CHANGED: the lease or attempt authority changed; this does not say the source is stale. POINT_PUBLICATION_CHANGED: the prepared point result or enrolled input changed before publication; nothing was accepted.
